title: Here's How To Get All Your Friends Arrested
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 14th, 2024. A landlord called 911 regarding 4 people who had broken into his vacant home and has been sleeping in there. When officers started to question them, it turned out that one of the guys had said he owned the house and invited his friends, unknowing to them that it was illegal to be inside. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
